text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging SRE oncall — high packet loss & BGP instability observed egressing via TransitX (AS64500) from us-west-2. Alerts: 70-85% packet loss, multiple withdraws. Root metrics spike at 12:03 UTC. thread_ts=2065012345
oncall-sre: I'm on call, looking now. Can someone grab BGP/flow graphs?
Kelsey M: I can take triage. Seeing large loss to several customer prefixes. Pulling traceroutes and BGP table snapshot.
Marco L: FYI we've got a known soft-flap with TransitX earlier today but it seemed to stabilize.
Kelsey M: traceroute to 198.51.100.23 (customer-host):
```
traceroute to 198.51.100.23, 30 hops max, 60 byte packets
 1  10.10.10.1  0.5 ms
 2  172.17.0.1  0.8 ms
 3  * * *  (30% loss)
 4  203.0.113.77  45.2 ms  (TransitX hop)
 5  198.51.100.23  46.1 ms (but with 70% packet loss)
```
Kelsey M: BGP table shows frequent withdraws for 198.51.100.0/24, originating AS64500 intermittently withdrawing our next-hop.
```
show ip bgp 198.51.100.0/24
Status: flapping
Paths: 64500 64496 64497 (preferred)
Last update: 12:02:41 UTC (withdrawn 12:02:49)
```
Marco L: Confirmed — TransitX is oscillating on that egress path. Need quick mitigation to restore customer traffic.
Kelsey M: Immediate mitigations proposal:
- Withdraw more-specifics to TransitX for impacted customer prefixes (temporary)
- Announce prepended path to backup provider (CarrierY) to steer traffic away
- Apply BGP community to de-prefer AS64500 where possible
Anyone object?
Priya R: Customers impacted list (preliminary): Acme Analytics, QuickForms, BotpressCorp. CS is on standby to notify top 3 and open support incidents.
deploy-bot: created ticket INC-8243 and started an incident bridge https://pager.example/INC-8243 :phone:
Kelsey M: I'm going to push a controlled route tweak to avoid broad churn. Executing via control-plane playbook:
```
# announce prepends to CarrierY for affected prefixes
curl -X POST https://api.routing.redwood.local/announce \
  -d '{"prefix":"198.51.100.0/24","as_path_prepend":2,"community":"no-export"}' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ****"
```
Kelsey M: Also adding a route-map to our eBGP session with TransitX to lower local pref for affected prefixes:
```
set as-path prepend 64500 64500
set community 65535:100 no-export
```
TransitX NOC: Received report, ticket TX-93811 opened. We're seeing instability on our upstream towards 64496. We will scrub and suppress flapping announcements from our edge and work with upstream peers.
Marco L: OK, CarrierY accepted the prepends and we see RIB change. Please monitor egress and packet loss graphs.
Kelsey M: Monitoring graphs now — loss dropping from ~75% -> ~10% over the last 3 minutes for a sample of prefixes.
Priya R: CS notified Acme & QuickForms at 12:10 UTC. They acknowledged and asked for ETA.
Kelsey M: ETA ~20m to be confident. Will keep incremental updates every 5m.
oncall-sre: tagging @eng-sre for post-change monitoring and possible rollback instructions.
deploy-bot: route update executed (job 78923), propagation observed on 3 upstreams.
Kelsey M: Observability checks:
- token-level latency for text-gen: normalized
- egress packet loss: trending down
- tail latencies reduced
If any new withdraws appear we'll revert the prepends.
Marco L: TransitX reports they applied an upstream filter at 12:14 UTC to prevent re-advert of the bad path. They will run BGP dampening adjustments.
TransitX NOC: Confirmed filter applied. We'll keep ticket open until stable for 1 hour.
Kelsey M: Customer impact summary for post-incident notes: brief egress packet loss affecting outbound connectivity to ~8 customer prefixes for ~18 minutes. No data corruption, mostly request timeouts and retries. CS escalations opened for 3 enterprise customers; PS engaged for any follow-ups.
Priya R: Logged affected customers in support tracker: SUP-5501, SUP-5502, SUP-5503. Drafting customer-facing blurb.
Kelsey M: Seeing stability for 15 minutes. Moving to monitor mode and will start handoff to next oncall in 30m.
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident severity downgraded to S2 at 12:31 UTC.
Kelsey M: Thanks all. Postmortem owners: Marco L (network), Kelsey M (ops). I'll create postmortem doc and link here. For now marking the incident as mitigated.
Customer Success: Notified customers that traffic has been re-routed and we're monitoring for full recovery.
Kelsey M: final check — packet loss back to <1% across the board. Closing bridge in 10m unless regressions.
incident-bot: Bridge closed at 12:45 UTC per oncall. Incident resolved. :tada:
Kelsey M: Kick-off postmortem tomorrow 16:00 UTC. Please capture timelines, provider comms, and any automation gaps.
